environment.server: production LiveKit via existing Jospar API
environment.android: isolated Android 36.1 emulator with emulated camera
environment.web: authenticated Jospar page with generated test audio/video

limitations: Physical iPhone camera and microphone were not tested: no physical phone is available.
iOS Simulator audio initialization was unstable (CoreAudio RPC timeout); one native session received 902 decoded frames and exchanged audio, but this is not a physical-device certification.
Incoming calls while the app is terminated are deferred by user decision.
